profile: Checked contiguous FP32 CUDA production source, with explicit compiler-selected kernel addition trees and actual Torch reduction plans
admission: All FP32 words and every Python float epsilon, including signed zeros, subnormals, NaNs and infinities; no finiteness or positivity guard.

operations.name: Native.add
operations.required_evidence: Actual scalar addition at every ordered tree node and chunk carry.

operations.name: Native.sub
operations.required_evidence: Actual source subtraction operand roles and exceptional behavior.

operations.name: Native.multiply
operations.required_evidence: Actual source product operand roles, NaN selection, signed zeros and FTZ behavior.

operations.name: Native.maximum
operations.required_evidence: Actual tl.maximum, including NaN behavior and epsilon clamp operand roles.

operations.name: Native.logarithm
operations.required_evidence: Installed tl.log lowering, including internal approximation/FMA/FTZ behavior.

operations.name: Native.exponential
operations.required_evidence: Installed tl.exp lowering, including internal scaling and approximation.

operations.name: Native.negate
operations.required_evidence: Actual unary negation in the log-target backward branch.

operations.name: Native.multiplyMinusOne
operations.required_evidence: Actual multiply-by-literal-minus-one lowering; separate from unary negation.

operations.name: Native.bindEpsilon
operations.required_evidence: Actual scalar ABI conversion to the source FP32 epsilon, including overflow, underflow and NaNs.

operations.name: Torch.add
operations.required_evidence: Actual scalar addition at each node of the returned Torch reduction plan.

operations.name: Torch.equal
operations.required_evidence: Actual scalar equality after the exact scalar-shape comparison.

operations.name: Torch.dividePythonNat
operations.domain: FP32 word and Python natural denominator
operations.required_evidence: Actual integer-scalar conversion and division, including zero and large denominators.

structural_not_deferred: exact ordered Python checks and public domain
complete typed row and grid execution
physical input binding, checked alias separation, native signed64 masks and active pointers
explicit kernel binary reduction plans and sequential chunk carry
actual rank-one reduced allocation and Torch sum(dim=0) or sum() plans
direct destination identity, returned product and all four output bytes
whole backing frames and destination complement on every ordinary host outcome
